errors.description: The model incorrectly perceived yellow as the most frequent color, while the ground truth confirms green appears 15 times (the highest count). This suggests the model either misidentified green cubes as yellow or failed to accurately track color distribution across the rotating 3D structure. The error is perceptual — the model saw the wrong color prevalence, not a logical flaw in reasoning about counts.

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed to correctly perceive the color distribution in the 3D cube structure. Despite accurately identifying the four colors and acknowledging the need to count visible cubes, it hallucinated that yellow was the most frequent color. This is a perception error, not a reasoning one — the model applied logical steps (observing rotation, comparing frequencies) but based them on incorrect visual input. The root cause is likely misattribution of color during dynamic viewing, possibly due to lighting, occlusion, or color similarity in the video frames.
